name: Warden
text:
Decision: We will run a full asset inventory scan of all our external-facing systems—web apps, APIs, databases, and cloud buckets—using a trusted, read-only scanner like OpenVAS or Nessus. This will give us a real-time map of what’s actually live, what ports are open, and where we might be leaking data or exposing weak services.

Trade-off: The scan will take time and may slow down some systems, but the risk of missing a hidden leak or an old, forgotten service is far worse. We’re choosing thoroughness over speed here—because if we don’t know what’s real, we can’t protect it.
